/.title: Vector · Air traffic control on real airspace
/.description: Vector is an air traffic control simulator for the radar room: New York, Chicago and Dallas–Fort Worth, built from real FAA data, with live weather and realistic pilots.

/airspaces.title: Airspaces · Vector
/airspaces.description: New York (N90), Chicago (C90) and Dallas–Fort Worth (D10): real TRACONs built from FAA data.

/airspaces/new-york.title: New York (N90) · Vector
/airspaces/new-york.description: Kennedy, LaGuardia and Newark: work the New York TRACON on real FAA procedures.

/airspaces/chicago.title: Chicago (C90) · Vector
/airspaces/chicago.description: O’Hare and Midway: triple approaches in west or east flow, on real FAA procedures.

/airspaces/dallas.title: Dallas–Fort Worth (D10) · Vector
/airspaces/dallas.description: DFW and Love Field: four arrival runways and RNAV SIDs, on real FAA procedures.
